name: Natsume Daigo
source:
Daigo is a resolute officer, dedicated to eliminating crime by any means necessary. He is also very devoted to his daughter [url=/c99715]Sakura[/url], and worked tirelessly to try and learn the truth behind her kidnapping. He has intimate knowledge of the true nature of crime, and believes that it must be eradicated completely to avoid transmission. He is very cautious and always warns others to follow orders exactly.    

[From the [url=https://killthepastwiki.com/Daigo_Natsume]Wiki[/url]]
